description: PR-fast scenario subset run by .github/workflows/perf-pr-fast.yml. Four scenarios chosen for broad coverage of the active code paths. Estimated combined wall-clock: < 120 s post-build on windows-2022. See docs/plans/shipped/pillar-1-2-perf-review-system.md § D4. ai-chat-history-render added in Phase 6.7 of ai-chat-claude-desktop-parity so AI chat panel render regressions surface at PR time without manual perf-run invocation. command-palette-fuzzy removed (perf-gate-revival step 2): it is bucket-C-only — CommandPaletteFuzzyScenario hard-requires --screenshotPath, which the perf path's scenario.run never passes — so it would be a guaranteed run_failure (hard exit 1) the moment any ci-windows-latest baseline lands.
